Every market has its characters. This one has a wagging tail.

Major Woof ($MWOOF) is a character-led meme on Robinhood Chain, pairing the warmth of a golden retriever with the confidence of a space-age officer. Cream-white styling, a green-trimmed uniform, and his signature seated pose give the major a look that feels both familiar and distinctive.

His world is onchain markets. His personality is pure golden retriever: loyal, curious, and always happy to see you. The uniform brings the presence; the smile brings the charm.

A good boy. A major presence.



Major Woof ($MWOOF) — A new recruit in the world of onchain finance, with the confidence of a major and the heart of a golden retriever.

Stationed on Robinhood Chain, this space-age good boy brings a familiar warmth to a fast-moving market. His mission has a playful twist: look sharp, stay curious, and try not to wag during the briefing.

Major Woof blends futuristic officer style with the charm of a dog you’d be happy to meet. A little rank. A lot of personality. One unmistakable golden face.

$SANTAHOOD is the native token of SANTRO EXCHANGE, the first centralized exchange on Robinhood Chain.

Built by the community, fueled by conviction, and driven by a long-term vision, SantaHood is expanding beyond the meme with Santro Exchange.

$SANTAHOOD serves as the governance token of the Santro ecosystem, with platform fees powering buybacks and burns.
